title: Integration of blood methylation and skin microbiome data for age prediction
desc: Microbiome–metadata integration reduced age-prediction MAE by 10.0% versus metadata alone across three repeated nested validations. Includes paired uncertainty estimates, study-specific effects, and a separately implemented blood–skin late-fusion architecture.
heroCaption: Repeated nested validation: 9.71-year metadata MAE versus 8.74 years for microbiome–metadata integration; conditional intervals and source-study effects.
